checked_profile.summary: Term and permanent life options offered through Northwestern Mutual financial professionals.
checked_profile.scope: Policy categories, application approach and selected product conditions on the provider overview. No company-wide issue-age or coverage maximum is inferred.

facts.label: Policy categories
facts.text: The provider lists term, whole, universal and variable universal life. Life insurance is issued by The Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance Company; product availability varies by state.

facts.label: Application process
facts.text: A financial professional helps obtain a quote. Some applicants may qualify for an accelerated process with a decision as soon as the same day, but additional underwriting can be required. A universal medical-exam requirement is not supported.

facts.label: Permanent-policy conditions
facts.text: Dividends are not guaranteed. Variable universal life cash-value accumulation is not guaranteed. Loans, withdrawals and surrenders can reduce policy values and the death benefit; ask for the policy-specific illustration and conditions.
